title: Out of Office
blurb: After you confirm, Settings writes a Gmail vacation reply, a Microsoft automatic reply, or an IMAP sieve script. Morrow does not send those replies itself. All Account Mail keeps a mailbox chooser and shows the selected mailbox's Out of Office status, not a merged on/off status. Status reads and Refresh check only that mailbox, never every account. Scheduled and Out of Office open dialogs from the same sidebar row. The Out of Office dialog has a labeled full-width Mailbox chooser, a readable selected address, and separate status and action rows. Close or Escape dismisses it and returns focus to its button. Collapse all folders keeps account sections in their current expanded or collapsed state. Every mailbox, including Yahoo and custom IMAP, has a collapse button and a separately saved expansion choice. Accounts without an individual choice inherit the previous Gmail/Outlook defaults; other accounts start expanded. Filtering temporarily reveals matching folders without saving expansion. A pending read shows Checking and prevents duplicate Refresh. When replies are disabled, both single-mailbox and All Account Mail views show Off with Manage and no Refresh. Manage opens the selected mailbox's Out of Office settings without writing. Provider replies preserve edits made during Save or Refresh as unsaved while updating the reviewed revision. Switching mailbox during a read cannot cache an unapplied result. Google mail/settings permission excludes Calendar; Microsoft uses its separate Graph bundle.
